dialogues.jp:
体育館にボールの弾む音が響く。最後の体育は、
自由行動になった。
dialogues.en:
All throughout the gym, the sound of balls bouncing on
tarmac could be heard. The final gym class was Free Action
mode.
dialogues.text:
All throughout the gym, the sound of balls bouncing on
tarmac could be heard. The final gym class was Free Action
mode.

dialogues.jp:
当然、俺は“体育館の隅に座って人間観察”を
選択する。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I chose to be in the "Observation While Sitting
In A Corner" group.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I chose to be in the "Observation While Sitting
In A Corner" group.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何やってるんだ朝倉。お前は混じらないの
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong, Asakura. Why aren't you mixing it up with the
rest of them?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong, Asakura. Why aren't you mixing it up with the
rest of them?"

dialogues.jp: そう言って、バスケをしている方を指す。
dialogues.en: Suginami came up to me twirling a basketball on his finger.
dialogues.text: Suginami came up to me twirling a basketball on his finger.

dialogues.en: "...Why are you wearing your school uniform?"
dialogues.text: "...Why are you wearing your school uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よんどころない事情だ。気にするな」
dialogues.en: "The reasons don't concern you. Don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "The reasons don't concern you. Don't worry about it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「で、どうして座敷わらしのように座ってる？」
dialogues.en: "And why are you just sitting on a tatami mat?"
dialogues.text: "And why are you just sitting on a tatami mat?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、自由行動なんだし、いいだろう」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's a Free Action class, what's wrong with it?"
dialogues.text: "Well, it's a Free Action class, what's wrong with it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ということで、俺はここで見てるから、お前
　は行って来い」
dialogues.en:
"Speaking of which, I saw you out there before you came
here, and you weren't wearing that."
dialogues.text:
"Speaking of which, I saw you out there before you came
here, and you weren't wearing that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「気にするな。その前に、自分で気にしてたの
　かお前……」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. I most definitely do not want to know what you
were doing."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. I most definitely do not want to know what you
were doing."

dialogues.jp:
違いない、そんな言葉を呟いて、杉並が去って
いく。その背中を見送り、再びぼんやりと視線
をおよがせる。
dialogues.en:
Definitely not, I muttered, as Suginami went back to the
playing courts. As I saw him off, my mind wandered
absent-mindedly.
dialogues.text:
Definitely not, I muttered, as Suginami went back to the
playing courts. As I saw him off, my mind wandered
absent-mindedly.

dialogues.jp: これが終われば、あとはＨＲだけ。
dialogues.en: After this, just HR is left.
dialogues.text: After this, just HR is left.

dialogues.jp:
いよいよこの自由参加のバスケが終れば、ＨＲ
を残すのみだ。
dialogues.en:
After this stupid self-participation basketball playabout is
over, just HR left to go...
dialogues.text:
After this stupid self-participation basketball playabout is
over, just HR left to go...
